heroHeadline: Malaysia Accelerates Sabah Defenses as Military Buildup Near Balabac Advances
heroSubtitle: Malaysia is accelerating defensive measures in Sabah as a military buildup near Balabac Island advances, reflecting heightened regional security concerns in the contested Balabac Strait connecting the South China Sea and Sulu Sea. The moves signal Kuala Lumpur's response to increased activity along a strategically vital chokepoint as South China Sea tensions continue to escalate.
